sections.text: Introduction

This document outlines the
equipment inspection checklist I1, which must be performed on a monthly bases as 
indicated by M1 in the title block.

The boiler area sump P/P 
(2 per unit) discharge
the condensate from boiler area sump to water treatment area

The technical specification of the condensate pump: 
R.P.M = 1450 
Suction pressure: 9144 mm H2O
T = 49/25C 
Discharge pressure: 304.8 mm H2O
HP = 10 Q = 10.3 LPS
Model = L.G P017 A,B

The first draft initiated by eng.
Ali El-Safoury, tested by eng. Mohamed Anwar Ghazy, accepted by general director 
eng. Gamal Abd El-Meguid El-Safoury, and approved by eng. Mohamed El-Tahawy: head sector of Shoubra El-Khimah PS.

This document revised by eng. Nageh Soliman Shousha: 
 CEPC quality control director, and certified by eng. Afaf Ebrahim 
 El-Dib: CEPC inspection & quality control's Head Sector and MPIS coordinator.
Safety Precautions

Work order must be issued and the
maintenance staff should the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with
caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear the safety and healthy equipment as 
safety helmet, shoes, earplugs etc.

Isolate the circuit breaker of P/P
motor.

Disconnect electric terminals of
motor.
Isolated delivery V/V.

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out

Lubricate 
bearing

Start P/P and check packing leakage 
and change the packing if needed.

Listen for unusual noise 
and repair the cause of abnormal noise if it is from the bearing or the motor.

Check bearing temperature 
so change the oil if needed or check the bearing (lubricate or change)

Record P/P discharge
pressure.

Clean sludge from bottom of tank 
by removing it manually then get rid of it in a safety place.

Inspect placite
lining of tank for checking and reline the defected parts of the tank
